text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

A panel's composition tells you almost nothing on its own. Mixed and single-sex panels occur routinely from who happens to be available in a given department, and clinical laboratory leadership is female-heavy in many places. Leading with "four women" makes you look like you're reaching, and it undermines the complaint you actually have a good case for.

Your real grievance is procedural: you asked for written reasons two weeks ago and got silence. Press that, in writing, with a deadline. Ask specifically how the criteria were weighted and how "broad leadership experience" was assessed against your eight years running a section.

If the reasons come back incoherent or shifting, then you have something. Get the facts first.
